experiment: E6 · concurrency on the Vol.1 stack
written_before: container launch and any E6 request (run_e6.sh refuses to start if this file or its .sha256 is missing or changed)

design.env: NIM_MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 · all other NIM settings default
design.questions: benchmark/questions.json (sha256 262f2339…) fixed order, cycled, restart at q001 per level
design.waves: 1 warmup wave per level (not counted) + max(3, ceil(100/c)) measured waves ⇒ every level covers all 100 questions at least once
design.per_request: Vol.1 E2 benchmark_nim timing logic; max_tokens=500; stream; temperature not set; timeout 90 s
design.stop_rule: any failed request at a level ⇒ stop scanning upward
design.runs: one run. Not repeated to obtain a different outcome.

predictions.claim: c=1 per-request tps avg within 70.7–95.7 (Vol.2 arm P avg 83.2 ±15%)
predictions.role: positive control: the concurrency harness at c=1 reproduces the single-request measurement on the same stack
predictions.basis: vol2/results/e7/e7_arm_p.json (same image, profile, env, per-request formula). Differences: no 2 s cooldown in E6; different window.
predictions.if_fails: harness or window differs from arm P ⇒ report; do not interpret higher levels as a concurrency effect without explaining this first

predictions.claim: aggregate fragments/s mean increases strictly from c=1 → 4 → 16
predictions.basis: continuous batching; no prior measurement on this stack ⇒ directional only

predictions.claim: TTFT p50 at the highest tested level > TTFT p50 at c=1
predictions.basis: queueing and prefill contention; directional only

predictions.claim: 0 failed requests at every level up to c=50
predictions.basis: vLLM queues requests beyond its batch capacity instead of rejecting them; timeout 90 s with max_tokens=500. Low confidence: never run on this stack.
predictions.reporting_rule: if true ⇒ 'no ceiling reached within 1–50', never 'the limit is 50'

not_predicted: behaviour between c=32 and c=50 (direction of aggregate throughput)
reporting: max_tokens 500 differs from the Nemotron concurrency curves (64) ⇒ not to be plotted side by side
statistics are labelled avg or p50 explicitly
